data.standardized_narrative: On a gross basis the Syndicate's prior year reserves showed a modest strengthening of approximately GBP 17.9m (c.1.39% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by adverse development across older underwriting years (primarily movements in UW 2011-2016). Management reports a contemporaneous net release of GBP 30.1m after reinsurance due to more favourable claims development and proactive claims handling and reinsurance recoveries. The portfolio was also impacted in the period by natural catastrophe losses (notably California wildfires and Hurricanes Michael and Florence in 2018), and by prior-year catastrophe activity in 2016 and 2017 (Alberta wildfires; Hurricanes Matthew, Harvey, Irma, Maria; Mexico earthquake).

This release is a result of more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
impacted by GBP 22.8m of natural catastrophe losses arising during the third and fourth quarters of 2018; (California wildfires; hurricane Michael; hurricane Florence).
The 2016 year was impacted by natural catastrophe losses on the Alberta wildfires and hurricane Matthew with losses of GBP 17.9m.
The 2017 year was impacted by several natural catastrophes with losses of GBP 74.6m; hurricane Harvey; hurricane Irma; hurricane Maria; Mexico earthquake; Northern and Southern California wildfires.

The decrease in reinsurers' share of claims outstanding during 2018 was primarily due the settlement of claims and proactive collection of reinsurance recoveries; partially offset by the 2018 natural catastrophe losses.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 36). Management narrative reports a net release of GBP 30.1m (after reinsurance) - that net figure is explicitly stated but is net of reinsurance. The triangle-based gross PYD (+GBP 17.88m) differs from the narrative net release; gross movement in the technical provisions reconciliation line is not used because it includes current-year movements. No RITC was identified. Confidence: gross triangle calculation = 0.8; narrative net release explicit but net of reinsurance.
